subject: Acme trial procurement readiness & billing path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jen Sullivan <jen.sullivan@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Acme trial — procurement readiness & next steps

Hi Jen,

Great to speak with you and Tom earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so the procurement path doesn't block the trial -> paid conversion: 

Recap from our call:
- Trial: 30-day trial we've provisioned for the Acme AI team; sandbox environment with sample datasets and monitoring dashboards.
- Success criteria (we discussed): 40k tokens/day average across peak week OR 100k embedding calls total, plus integration of result into the internal search UI with <500ms median latency.
- Primary blockers you flagged: PO requirement for pilot billing, legal review window (expected 2–3 weeks), and interest in paying via AWS Marketplace if possible.

Proposed commercial paths and asks:
1) Card-on-file: fastest path — we can start billing as soon as the trial end date is reached and you confirm to charge the card on file.
2) PO / invoice: we can accept a PO. To start billing at trial end we need: a signed purchase order referencing deal ID RWI-ACME-4921 and a billing contact email. We can issue an invoice on the preferred cadence.
3) Marketplace: we can list on AWS Marketplace but that process can add ~2–4 weeks to finalize (if you want this route, we should kick off now).

Attachments: I attached an updated quote (redwood-quote-v2.pdf) and a draft SOW (sow-draft.docx) that reflect the pilot capacity and potential ramp.

Next steps I recommend:
- Jen: confirm which commercial path you'd prefer (card / PO / marketplace) and the billing contact for PO routing.
- Tom/procurement: if PO route, please share Acme PO template or a sample PO number so our finance team can verify fields.
- Redwood (Ben + Monica): we'll provision billing settings and prepare a one-page PO-to-invoice guide for your procurement team.

If it helps, Ben can jump on a quick call with your procurement team tomorrow to walk through typical fields we include on our invoices.

Thanks,

— Marissa
Marissa Cole

From: Jen Sullivan <jen.sullivan@acme.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement readiness & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is helpful.

A few clarifications from procurement side:
- Our preference is PO/invoice for any pilot that will be paid by central IT. Card-on-file is OK for initial testing with a dev team, but procurement requires a PO for anything that will be billed to our cost center.
- We are evaluating AWS Marketplace for recurring purchases; if Redwood is in Marketplace it would simplify approvals. Can you confirm if Redwood already has an AWS Marketplace listing and how quickly we could be onboarded?
- For the PO route, our typical timeline is: internal approvals (1 week), AP processing (1 week) — so we should be able to issue a PO within ~10 business days if legal is OK.

Also: can you confirm the exact billing start date if we issue a PO mid-trial? E.g., if trial started yesterday and PO goes through during the trial, will billing start immediately upon PO acceptance or at the trial end?

On success criteria — Tom and I will validate the numbers with the engineering leads but the thresholds you listed look right. We'll follow up with a sample PO template by end of day tomorrow.

- Jen
Jen Sullivan
Head of Product | Acme Corp
jen.sullivan@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jen Sullivan <jen.sullivan@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme trial — procurement readiness & next steps

Jen — thanks, good questions. Short answers below and a note on next steps.

Marketplace: Redwood is live on AWS Marketplace for our standard hosted plans; Dedicated/Private deployments require a separate PO process. If you want Marketplace procurement for the pilot, we can confirm the entitlement SKUs today and estimate onboarding ~2 weeks for account linking and listing acceptance. If Acme prefers to buy via Marketplace, we should start that flow now.

Billing start date with PO: We can support two approaches and will mirror whichever you prefer:
A) Billing starts on trial end date (recommended): if you submit PO during the trial, we will reserve capacity and only begin invoicing on the trial end date (this avoids double-billing). For this we need a purchase order number and a signed cover page or email confirmation to attach to the invoice.
B) Billing starts on PO acceptance (alternate): we can begin invoicing as soon as finance accepts the PO — if you need immediate activation and payment, pick this.

For the PO route, finance will need these fields on the PO (we'll attach a one-pager): legal name (Redwood Inference, Inc.), remit-to address, tax id, PO number, billing contact, and the reference to deal RWI-ACME-4921.

Trial-to-paid readiness checklist (to hit before billing start):
- Usage thresholds met: 40k tokens/day for peak week OR 100k total embedding calls.
- Integration verification: UI renders results with <500ms median latency on your staging environment.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 documentation is attached in the portal; if you need an extracted evidence pack, Monica can send it.

Next steps:
- Jen/Tom: send PO template/sample to procurement@redwood.com and confirm preferred billing start (trial-end vs PO-accept).
- Monica: I copied Monica to prepare the PO one-pager and the SOC2 evidence summary. Ben, please stand by to join procurement call if needed.

I attached the updated quote and SOW again for convenience.

— Marissa

Marissa/Ben —

We received the sample SOW and quote — thanks. We prefer the PO/invoice route. We'll send a PoC PO (pilot PO) by next Thursday with the required fields. Please send the Redwood remit/tax details and the one-page PO checklist to this email so our AP team can validate.

Also confirm: if we send a pilot PO on 2026-03-30 (during the trial), we'd like billing to start on the trial end date (2026-04-24). Please confirm that's acceptable and that Redwood will hold billing until trial end.
